motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Approve the batch of routine consent items
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, the group of routine items passed together in one vote; the individual items are not listed in this record.
motions.impact: This is routine housekeeping — nothing changes for residents.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.10.030 Definitions and Enacting Chapter 17.59 Easements
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.10.030 Definitions and Enacting Chapter 17.59 Easements. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New city rules for easements on private land
motions.summary: The city added a new easements chapter to its code and updated related definitions, setting written rules for easements where none existed before.
motions.impact: This mostly affects developers and property owners dealing with easements on their land, who now have explicit city rules to follow. For most residents, nothing changes day to day.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Eagle Mountain City Facilities Master Plan.
motions.motion: Councilmember Burnham moved to approve a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, accepting the Galloway report as a guideline for future adoption of the Eagle Mountain City Facilities Master Plan. The motion died for a lack of a second.
motions.headline: No action on a city facilities master plan
motions.summary: The council took no action on a proposal to use the Galloway report as a guideline toward a future city facilities master plan.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents. The city still has no adopted facilities master plan, and the council would have to take the question up again.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Eagle Mountain City Public Art Plan.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Eagle Mountain City Public Art Plan. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Adopt a public art plan for the city
motions.summary: The city adopted a public art plan to guide how Eagle Mountain approaches public art going forward.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for you day to day. The plan sets direction only — it does not fund, buy, or place any specific piece of art.

motions.item_title: Add a review of Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.25 Residential Zones to the Legislativ…
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to add a review of Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.25 Residential Zones to the Legislative Priorities List. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Put the city's residential zoning rules up for review
motions.summary: The council added a review of Eagle Mountain's residential zoning rules, Chapter 17.25 of the city code, to its list of legislative priorities.
motions.impact: Nothing changes yet. This only puts the rules governing homes and lots in line for a future look, and any actual change would have to come back to the council.
